rules: Evidence Integration does not adjudicate deception, knowledge, Lie Ledger eligibility or Web of Lies lineage.
Keep Hamas and Houthi support propositions separate.
Distinguish support, weapons/funding, strategic guidance, operational assistance, operation-specific direction and organization-wide command/control.

referrals.topic: Iran's claimed negotiation intent versus conduct
adjudication_requested: truth/consistency predicates under Claims Forensics authority

referrals.topic: Iran's regional-stability claims versus contemporaneous conduct
do_not_infer: regional instability automatically proves deceptive intent

adjudication_requested: reconcile Reuters and AP multi-source reporting
distinguish operation-specific direction from broader campaign direction and organization-wide command
do_not_infer: Iranian control over every Houthi action

adjudication_requested: evaluate financing/weapons/training/strategic-support evidence separately from the Houthi relationship
do_not_infer: Houthi command findings transfer to Hamas
foreknowledge or command absent direct evidence

context_only.disposition: NO_CLAIMS_FORENSICS_ADJUDICATION_REQUEST_FROM_EVIDENCE_INTEGRATION; retain only if a later exact proposition requires it.
